name: chat-bubbles
description: Chat Bubbles: Claude's replies in soft rounded bubbles, your messages under your name with a corner line, every tool call as a named line (Code Edited, Hindsight Recall, Tool Used) that opens to show what was done, and the turn time under each finished reply.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Turn Chat Bubbles off to get Claude Code's normal transcript back.

bubbles.title: Chat bubbles
bubbles.description: Draw Claude's replies in rounded bubbles, and your messages under your name with a corner line.

userName.title: Your name
userName.description: Shown above your messages. Shell lines and slash commands show the folder instead.

quietTools.title: Named tool calls
quietTools.description: Show each tool call, or a run of them, as one named line (File Read, Code Edited, Hindsight Recall, Tool Used). Press a line to see what was done. Errors still show in full.

lineUnderReply.title: Line under each reply
lineUnderReply.description: Draw a mark and how long the turn took under each finished reply.
